newsitem.title: JAPAN: Acom to cut top interest rate on loans.
newsitem.headline: Acom to cut top interest rate on loans.

text.p: Consumer financing company Acom Co Ltd said on Monday that it would cut the highest interest rate it charges on loans to customers to 27.375 percent per year from 28.47 percent currently, effective April 1.
It will also introduce new annual interest rates of 22.50 percent and 21.50 percent for its loans, the company said in a statement.
"We expect to cut costs and better serve our customers through the steps," an Acom spokesman said.
The introduction of new rates will narrow the spread between current available rates, the company spokesman said.
